name: Context Menu UI
description: UI interaction spec for the floating right-click context menu with singleton enforcement.

dom.style: position:absolute; min-width:160px; padding:4px 0; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface); box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); z-index:6000; font-size:11px; font-family:Space Mono

interactions.name: create_menu
interactions.action: Remove all existing menus in static openMenus array, create new .ctx-menu at (x,y), append to body, register in openMenus

interactions.name: singleton
interactions.trigger: Second ContextMenu created while one exists
interactions.action: forEach openMenus → remove() before creating new one

states.open: Menu visible at (x,y), document click listener active
states.closed: Menu removed from DOM, listener cleaned up, onClose fired
